    • eventually

      public static void eventually(Duration timeout, LightkeeperAssertions.RetryingAssertion assertion)
      Retries an assertion until it passes or the timeout expires.

      Eager assertions never poll; this is the visible opt-in retry over the exact same assertion. The assertion is re-run in full — probe and matcher — every 50 ms, so it only makes sense over LIVE subjects that re-query the server per call (block types, inventories, menus, messages, server errors); retrying a frozen snapshot can never change the outcome and simply burns the timeout.

      On timeout, the thrown AssertionError carries the retry history (attempt count and elapsed time) and the last attempt's failure as its cause — strictly more information than a generic "condition not met". A non-assertion exception (e.g. a closed framework) fails fast on the first occurrence instead of burning the timeout; nesting eventually inside eventually is detected and rejected.

      Parameters:
      timeout - Maximum time to keep retrying; must be positive.
      assertion - The assertion to retry, typically a lambda re-running an eager assertThat(...) chain.
